examples.name: Default
examples.summary: A `Button` trigger that opens the popover. The panel content is composed by part — here a header (title + close) and a free-form body.

examples.name: Placements
examples.summary: The four vertical corners and the two inline sides (`side="end"`, `side="start"`) side-by-side; every side takes `align` `start`, `center` or `end`, and `start` / `end` follow the text direction. Click a trigger to open its panel and see how it anchors against the trigger.

examples.name: AutoPlacement
examples.summary: `side="auto"` lets the popover choose the side with the most room at open time. The four triggers below all use the same value. Click one to open its panel: each, anchored near a different viewport corner, resolves toward the side with the most available space.

examples.name: Anatomy
examples.summary: Region combinations side-by-side — click a trigger to open each: (a) `PopoverHeader` (title + description) + body + `PopoverFooter`, (b) header with title only + body, and (c) body-only with no header or footer. `PopoverHeader`, `PopoverDescription`, and `PopoverFooter` are all optional — compose the panel by part.

examples.name: Widths
examples.summary: The `size` prop presets — click a trigger to open each: `small` (`var(--container-xs)`, 348px), `medium` (`var(--container-sm)`, 408px), and `large` (`var(--container-md)`, 472px). When `size` is omitted the panel sizes fluidly between `var(--container-3xs)` and `var(--container-xs)`.

examples.name: FilterBuilder
examples.summary: A filter builder composed from `Popover` + `Select` + `Input` + `Button` — a real usage, not a new variant. The header carries the title/description/close; the body is a `New Filter` row (field select, operator select, value input); the footer holds Cancel / Apply. It keeps light-dismiss on: `Escape` or a click outside closes it (a draft filter is cheap to lose), while picking an option in a nested `Select`, whose menu teleports to `<body>`, counts as inside the panel. The header close, Cancel and Apply close it too, driven by `v-model:open`.
